posts.title: Celebrating Artist Jerry Ordway
posts.description: Celebrating the birthday of artist Jerry Ordway (November 28, 1957), with a couple of his covers featuring Superman dealing with the Manhunters and the Millennium...from Adventures Of Superman #436 and #437 , January and February, 1988.

posts.title: Happy Thanksgiving
posts.description: A happy Thanksgiving to all, and may your day be less eventful than the Simpsons day, with a pilgrim Homer dealing with a familiar turkey from Simpsons #51 (October, 2000) by Bill Morrison and Mike Rote, to a fight for the turkey from Simpsons Classic #26 (Fall, 2010).

posts.title: Pooch In Action
posts.description: A couple of covers of Pooch in action in the Pacific theatre, fighting with and without Gunner and Sarge, in Our Fighting Forces #63 and #67 (September-October, 1961 and April, 1962), under covers by Jerry Grandenetti .
